# Google Translate

> > Free, instant translation service supporting 100+ languages with real-time language detection and multilingual support.

Google Translate is a web-based translation platform providing instant translation capabilities across a wide range of languages. The service offers seamless text translation with automatic language detection and a user-friendly language picker interface.

## Core Translation Service

- [Google Translate](https://translate.google.uz): Free instant translation service for 100+ languages with automatic language detection and multilingual support
